background_fill_rule.rationale: V3_CROP_ONLY contains no padding operation and no reusable historical fill rule was located in inspected pre-05K artifacts. The rule therefore uses a pre-existing frozen per-image background statistic rather than a post-outcome quantity.

integrity_requirements: Inserted V3 source patch must be pixel-identical to the frozen source raster.
Inserted patch SHA256 must equal the frozen V3 output_pixel_sha256.
No source pixel may be clipped.
Padding offsets must equal the frozen symmetric integer construction rule.
s=1.00 must reproduce the original V3 raster exactly.
Foreground/intensity invariants are diagnostic checks only and must not redefine the construction.
